headings.strategy: Bold, square-ish, precise. Use tracking-tight for H1-H3. Never center align technical dashboard headings.

body.strategy: Clean, highly legible at small sizes, excellent for dense data UI.

numbers_and_math.strategy: CRITICAL: All thermodynamic properties (P, T, v, h, u, s), metrics, and Professor Mode outputs MUST use this monospace font. Ensures decimal alignment in dense tables.

background.description: Cool-tinted deep slate (slate-950) for a precise, scientific lab environment. Do not use pure black.

accents.primaryDescription: Signal Red - Used for Heat additions (Qin), high temperature states, and primary CTAs.
accents.secondaryDescription: Cyan / Klein Blue - Used for Cooling (Qout), liquid phases, and secondary interactive elements.
accents.warningDescription: Amber - Used for state transitions, work (W) outputs, and alerts.

dashboard_grid.strategy: Strict grid hierarchy. Use CSS Grid with 1px border-collapse style. 'Expose the skeleton' — border-r and border-b on grid items to create a technical blueprint feel.
dashboard_grid.spacing: Tight internal padding (p-4 or p-6) for high information density. External gaps can be 0 if using the 1px grid border strategy.

layouts.alignment: Strictly Left-aligned for data, tables, and forms. Center alignment is banned for technical data displays.

surfaces.cards: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Flat backgrounds, 1px visible borders (border-slate-800), NO soft shadows. Instead of shadows, use subtle colored left-borders (border-l-2) to denote state (e.g., red for hot, blue for cold).
surfaces.headers: Solid background with a hard bottom border (border-b border-slate-800). No glassmorphism in the main scientific workbench to prevent visual refraction of dense data.

component_instructions.tables: Must be dense, highly structured. Sortable headers. Hover effects on rows (bg-slate-800/50). Numbers must be right-aligned and monospace.
component_instructions.inputs: Shadcn UI forms. Square or slightly rounded (rounded-sm max). Focus rings must be high-contrast Signal Red or Cyan.
component_instructions.tabs: Flat, pill-less. Active state should be a 2px bottom border (Signal Red) over a transparent background.
component_instructions.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm or rounded-none). Primary action in Signal Red. Secondary in Outline style.
component_instructions.interactive_diagrams: Recharts for P-v, T-s, P-h graphs. The charts MUST have a grid background (stroke-dasharray='3 3' stroke='#1e293b'). Axis labels must be JetBrains Mono. Data lines should glow (use drop-shadow in SVG or thick 2px strokes).
component_instructions.professor_mode: Use a specialized 'Terminal/Retro-Futurism' micro-theme. Deep indigo/black background, monospace fonts, step-by-step progressive disclosure (using Accordions or step lists).

visual_enhancers.motion: Minimalist. Micro-interactions for hover states. Tooltips must appear instantly (no long delays) because experts scan quickly. Transitions on property updates should flash softly (e.g., bg-slate-800 to transparent) to indicate data change.
visual_enhancers.accessibility: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for all text. Focus rings must be 2px solid. All properties MUST include units (kJ/kg, MPa, K) next to the value.

required_libraries.name: @phosphor-icons/react
required_libraries.purpose: Technical and dense dashboard iconography. Use 'regular' or 'light' weights.

required_libraries.name: recharts
required_libraries.purpose: For interactive 2D thermodynamic diagrams (P-v, T-s, Mollier).

required_libraries.name: react-latex-next
required_libraries.purpose: MANDATORY for 'Professor Mode' step-by-step symbolic + numeric derivations.

testing.attributes: All interactive elements, input fields, calculation outputs, and unit toggles MUST include `data-testid` in kebab-case.

images.description: Abstract technical dark grid background. Use for the login/signup page or marketing hero section with a heavy opacity overlay (bg-slate-950/80).

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. In frontend design, this creates what users call the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling. You MUST NOT center align the app container.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use the specified icon library.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Do NOT apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
All calculation output values MUST use the specified monospace font (`JetBrains Mono`).
DO NOT use a transparent background for the header. It must have a solid background color.
Never use placeholder URLs. If an image is needed, use the provided auth_background.
